description.narrative: Biodiversity Conservation targeting southern landscape of Kenya in Narok, Kajiado and Taita Taveta

Biodiversity Conservation targeting southern landscape of Kenya in Narok, Kajiado and Taita Taveta. Outcome 1: Restored, enhanced, and protected biodiversity for increased climate resilience in productive and protective landscapes Outcome 2: Improved livelihood of communities through biodiversity­based enterprises and developed value chains Outcome 3: Strengthened and coordinated community­based knowledge and national monitoring systems for biodiversity conservation Outcome 4: Enhanced County capacity for climate change mainstreaming into County biodiversity and environmental policies and plans. Outcome 5: Enhanced governance of community land to strengthen biodiversity conservation and protections including benefits for rights holder

This project is implemented by partners' - African Wildlife Foundation (AWF) who are a major international conservation organization focused on protecting wildlife and habitats in Africa.
The focus of this contribution is on conserving and restoring Southern Kenya's ecosystems and their services to improve resilience, integrity, and connectivity to deliver sustainable and decent livelihoods.
An integrated approach to conservation, development, and human well-being will ensure that productive use of land and related resources are planned to safeguard and restore important critical productive assets and ecosystem services and bend the curve on biodiversity loss so that these ecosystems and biodiversity underpin sustainable inclusive socio-economic development and the well-being of the targeted communities.
The following objectives are pursued:
Objective 1: Restored, enhanced, and protected biodiversity for increased climate resilience in productive and protective landscapes Objective 2: Improved livelihood of communities through biodiversity-based enterprises and developed value chains Objective 3: Strengthened and Coordinated community-based knowledge and national monitoring systems for biodiversity conservation Objective 4: Enhanced County capacity for climate change mainstreaming into County biodiversity and environmental policies and plans Objective 5: Enhanced governance of community land to strengthen biodiversity conservation and protections including benefits for rights holders
